parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type.

For more information about the supported resource types, see the **Resource type** column in [Services that work with Resource Group](~~94479~~).

parameters.name: ResourceTypes
parameters.description:
The resource types. A maximum of 50 resource types are supported.

>  If you configure `ResourceTypes`, you must configure both `Service` and `ResourceType`. Otherwise, the configured Service or ResourceType does not take effect.

parameters.name: Service
parameters.description:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud service.

You can obtain the ID from the **Service code** column in [Services that work with Resource Group](~~94479~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager list-resources --resource-group-id rg-uPJpP0000 --service ecs --biz-region cn-hangzhou --resource-type instance --resource-id i-23v380000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --resource-types Service=ecs ResourceType=instance --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcemanager ListResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceTypes.1.Service ecs --ResourceGroupId 'rg-uPJpP0000' --PageSize 10 --ResourceTypes.1.ResourceType instance --ResourceId 'i-23v380000' --PageNumber 1 --Service ecs --Region 'cn-hangzhou' --ResourceType instance --method POST --force
